scope: Eleven remaining client polish requests, including the user's fixed category/icon ordering choice

changes.1: Full bunny/flower Home and partner-room taps use one non-blocking white-on-translucent-black toast. It sits above Home tabs, replaces the previous message, and expires two seconds after the latest tap. Navigation and identity changes clear it.
changes.2: Onboarding paywall completion immediately paints the shared Splash while existing consent, authentication, setup writes, bootstrap and artwork preparation continue. Duplicate completion is locked; failures restore a retryable flow. Successful navigation does not briefly repaint the paywall.
changes.3: Plushie heart particles live approximately two seconds and keep rising. Bounded pools, reduced-motion behavior and the existing UI-thread clock remain unchanged.
changes.4: Empty Game, Memories and Surprise history entries stay in the current room and use the shared toast. Metadata is warmed/coalesced, unknown cold state is verified, and read errors are not mislabeled as empty. Same-game history is keyed by round/session ID, retaining independent win/loss records.
changes.5: Game and Memories use the same Feather clock as Surprise. Memories and Surprise history are native stack entries; Game history and the shared native history-card policy retain edge-only right-swipe back. Active editing/saving guards remain.
changes.6: Collection Items heading uses the Shop category name. Starter/Default outfit is excluded from Collection entries/counts. Owned item entry retains ownedOnly, ownerId and itemId, with existing inventory-filtered Decorate and checkout validation.
changes.7: Collection Gifts uses the shared Home gift library, with 15 categories and locked empty categories. Category details retain owned-item selection, Place on bookshelves, server confirmation and safe return to Collection.
changes.8: Decorate's top-right Done label is Replace.
changes.9: Plushie creation, photo source and daily-limit copy updated as requested. Existing Free/Plus daily quota enforcement remains unchanged.
changes.10: Frame crop hint is Drag to position your photo. The title and actual crop geometry remain unchanged.
changes.11: Moments normalizes record selections to the picker's fixed question/category/icon order for all 391 current icons. Optional icons follow defaults within their category; historical/unknown IDs remain at a deterministic tail. The original record arrays, saved labels and permissions are not changed. This removes differences between unordered Bootstrap items and item-ID-sorted history responses.
